topic: A neighbor wants to install a fence
text: I understand that fences can provide privacy and security, and I see the value in that for my neighbor. I've been thinking about the conversation we had. It's just that I wasn't expecting this, and it's made me realize how much I appreciate our open space. I've been contemplating how this change might affect our view and maybe even our relationship. I wonder if there are other options, like lower fencing or some kind of landscaping that could serve the same purpose without feeling so... final. I want to support my neighbor, but I also want to make sure we're both comfortable with the outcome. Maybe we can talk more about it, explore all the possibilities?
